topIssues.title: Screen Curtain fails to enable during post-sign-in Windows OOBE because desktop BitBlt verification fails
topIssues.bodyExcerpt:
### Brief summary

When NVDA starts automatically immediately after a successful Windows PIN sign-in, Screen Curtain fails to enable if the post-sign-in Windows OOBE ("You're almost done setting up your PC") is displayed.

The problem has been reproduced with both NVDA 2026.1.1 and NVDA 2026.2 beta

recentComments.author: phamhungvuong302
recentComments.excerpt:
Hi @seanbudd and @SaschaCowley.
I am glad you proposed a solution. I really hope this issue gets fixed soon and that the Screen Curtain feature continues to improve. Thank you.

recentComments.author: SaschaCowley
recentComments.excerpt: @seanbudd I was thinking of adding an exponential cooldowntimer to the retry loop. I.e. wait, say, 10, then 20, then 40ms. I think 500ms is way too long for something that may be blocking.

recentComments.author: seanbudd
recentComments.excerpt: This could be fixed by extending the retry time out for intializing screen curtain. we could delay each check by 500ms or similar.

topIssues.title: Make the announcement number of repeated symbols configurable instead of always being more than 3
topIssues.bodyExcerpt:
### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.

Currently, When We enter an emoji repeatedly more than 3, It will announce number of entered ones instead of announcing emoji name for all. For example If I enter this emoji 3 times 😭😭😭 And read it, I here crying face crying face cr

recentComments.author: Efury1
recentComments.excerpt:
Hi @seanbudd  @amirmahdifard, I think I found the code responsible for this behavior:
```
# Repeated characters: more than 3 repeats.
r"(?P<repeated>(?P<repTmp>%s)(?P=repTmp){3,})" % characters,
```
